description: Latest intraday price for ONE US-listed ticker, live from Tiingo's IEX feed (IEX only, not consolidated). PAID PLANS ONLY. Read as_of, the quote's time: after hours it is the last session's final print, and a thin name's as_of can be old mid-session. iex_session_volume is IEX-only. An uncovered or no-longer-trading symbol returns result null with not_found_reason, never a stale price; delisted_since is never inferred from prices. flat_session null = could not test. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_intraday_quote One call = one ticker. Close Prices from Tiingo.com.
name: get_intraday_quote
